goal: Compare fixed hard-SL, no-SL return waiting, delayed entry/early TP, bounded hedge, partial-profit/BE, and multi-pair rotation under one bid/ask MTM and margin accounting contract.
forbidden: broker, Paper, live, order, deploy, authentication, or position mutation

standard_replay_contract.claim_boundary: The research-local replay below is not represented as the missing standard worker replay.

real_data.source: local OANDA M1 complete bid/ask gzip artifacts, read-only
real_data.schedule: first 200 observed weekdays; one 08:00 UTC decision per day; pair cycles in the listed order
real_data.missing_rows: no interpolation; a decision with an incomplete causal window is SKIP_MISSING

decision_rule.scan: at 08:00 UTC, direction is the sign of the last completed 60-minute midpoint return
decision_rule.atr: mean one-minute midpoint true range over the same 60 completed bars multiplied by 12
decision_rule.wait_return: observe an adverse pullback of at least 0.25 ATR, then a completed five-minute close back in the selected direction
decision_rule.entry: first executable M1 open after confirmation
decision_rule.entry_slippage: 0.10 of observed entry spread, adverse, charged separately
decision_rule.exit_slippage: 0.10 of observed exit spread, adverse, charged separately
decision_rule.quote_conversion: JPY quote=1; USD quote uses latest causal USD_JPY midpoint
decision_rule.financing: unknown for counterfactual open legs; any rollover-crossing result is NOT_EVALUABLE_FINANCING
decision_rule.terminal: open legs remain open and are marked to final executable bid/ask; never force-closed

accounting.hedging_account_margin: sum per-pair max(long notional, short notional) margin; double-gross also reported
accounting.netting_account: opposite same-pair order reduces or reverses exposure and realizes the reduced original; it is not labelled a hedge
accounting.margin_closeout: when terminal-equity <= broker-margin * ratio, liquidate at executable bid/ask and count explicit failure
accounting.equity: cash realized + original MTM + hedge MTM
accounting.profit_factor: positive decision-level terminal contribution divided by absolute negative contribution
accounting.unresolved_inventory: any original or hedge leg still open at terminal

H1_LOCK_AT_ADVERSE_LEVEL_AND_WAIT.hedge_exit: only with original recovery; otherwise terminal MTM

H5_HEDGE_PROFIT_OFFSET_ORIGINAL_BE.unwind: combined realized hedge profit plus original executable MTM must be nonnegative

selection_rule: No best trigger is selected after results. Every trigger row is reported separately. A positive net with unresolved inventory, financing unknown, or margin closeout is REJECT/NOT_EVALUABLE, never ACCEPT.
